changes.comment: A domain rule (`MICA_ADMIT_DOMAINS`) with Google now also needs the account's Workspace domain (the `hd` claim) to be an admitted domain. Google reports a personal account with a company address as verified, so before this, such an account could get in, also after the company removed the person. This tightens admission: a personal Google account needs `MICA_ADMIT_EMAILS`. Put the primary domain of your Workspace in `MICA_ADMIT_DOMAINS`. Editors who sign in with Google through a domain rule must sign in again after the upgrade.
